title: Dalton Fury: Bin Laden in sights three times, strike denied
summary: John Blitch tells of Dalton Fury: Bin Laden in sights three times, strike denied, about 2001 at Tora Bora, Afghanistan, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he went on 60 Minutes in disguise to tell Scott Pell that he had Direct OverWatch on Bin Laden on three separate occasions

plain: John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the US military's advanced research agency, passes on a story from a soldier who wrote under the name Dalton Fury in a book called Kill Bin Laden. Blitch says Fury went on 60 Minutes, an American TV news programme, in disguise and told reporter Scott Pelley that in 2001 at Tora Bora in Afghanistan he had Osama bin Laden directly in view three separate times, but was not allowed to strike.
